series_annotator.narrative: The series exhibits mixed trend direction and moderate seasonality, but high spectral entropy indicates unpredictable noise. Concept drift and unstable model rankings suggest robust baselines (e.g., median) are preferable to complex combinations.

reasoning.robust_median: series_profile.noise.unpredictable=true → high spectral entropy indicates near-white-noise; robust_median is preferred over mean for outlier resistance
reasoning.inverse_rmse_weights_k4_sh0.35: series_profile.model_landscape.rmse_spread_ratio=0.9901 shows large RMSE variation; inverse weighting captures performance differences with shrinkage (recommended_knobs.shrinkage=0.35) to avoid overfitting with few windows
reasoning.ade_dynamic_error_beta0.5_trim0.8: series_profile.model_landscape.concept_drift=true → recency-weighted ADE method adapts better to changing model performance

excluded_highlights.stl_hierarchical_stacking_p2_sh0.0: series_profile.combination_recommendation.avoid contains 'stl_hierarchical_stacking' due to high noise and unstable rankings
